correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md specifies open neighborhoods N(i)=i+{-3,-2,-1,1,2,3} and an n>=13 short-arc normalization. We reconstructed the ten ordered free-face orbit removals and periodic R=Q[t,t^-1] boundary template, and independently computed D1D2=D2D3=0 as Laurent-polynomial matrices, a unit 5x5 minor of D2, a unit 4x4 minor of D3, and a 5x5 minor of D3 equal to -(t+1). These certify Smith factors (t-1), five units, and four units plus t+1; tensoring with R/(t^n-1) and PID UCT yields the parity-sensitive homology and rotation eigenvalues. Independent fixed-face trace sums in dimensions 0..5 were [1,-6,-2,4,0,-1] for odd n, [2,-6,-4,6,0,-2] for even n/even j and [0,-6,0,2,0,0] for even n/odd j, giving higher reflection signs; the degree-one circle map reverses under s. Rational averaging after barycentric subdivision proves ordinary quotient invariant-homology identities. The finite n=13..25 collapse replays alone would not prove all n, so uniform locality of 13 distinct residues and the explicit free-face incidence test were checked as the needed universal argument.

value.rationale: Classifies all positive-degree rational D_n representations for a natural infinite graph family, distinguishing the two even-order reflection classes and computing the rational topology of two different symmetry quotients. These are structural refinements of a known sphere-bundle topology and are not mechanical Betti-number restatements.

final_claim: For all n>=13 the open Lovasz neighborhood complex of C_n^3 has rational H_1 with r=+1,s=-1, and for even n exactly H_2 (r=-1,s=-1) and H_3 (r=-1,s=+1), with no further positive rational homology. Full D_n orbit space has only rational H_0; rotation quotient has rational H_0,H_1.
limitations: Only n>=13, rational representations for natural D_n, and ordinary orbit-space homology are classified; no integral equivariant lattice or quotient homotopy claimed.
The 13-vertex local incidence proof is universal; finite sample replays are corroborative, not its substitute.
Any historical unreviewed source metadata claims of independent validation are not treated as evidence.
No independent expert or Lean certification is claimed.
